item.title: ExileCon 2026 Cosplay and Costume Weapons Policy
item.description:
If you intend to cosplay and bring any kind of weapons from in-game please make sure that they are not actually functional in any way, as it is extremely likely that your costume weapon would not be allowed in through the security check.

All costume weapons will be inspected thoroughly by event staff before being allowed admittance into ExileCon and will be tagged once they are deemed okay. The tags should not be altered or removed from the item, or the weapon may be confiscated.

item.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 10/6/2026
item.description:
TESTING:

Starting tomorrow, October 7th at approximately 10am PT, we will be conducting a matchmaking test by enabling cross-play as the default option for all players, on all platforms in the US-West servers. The intention of this test is to shorten queue times and tighten matchmaking skill bands. This test will run until the season ends on November 3rd. Console players can opt out of the test by turning off cross-play in your settings menu.

item.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
item.description:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:

  • Added sv_wallbug convar to allow previous movement behavior on community servers (related to the missed note at the bottom)
  • Fixed view jitter that occurs and persists when playing for extended periods of time
  • Fixed snd_mix_async from crashing the game
  • Fixed sv_parallel_sends
